{{Top|leg}}
'''121 1''' were a trio of [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI bulk transports]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

The three transports were present at [[Vergesso Base]] during the [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards]] when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] learned of the Rebel presence in the area, and launched a massive assault led by the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. In the assault, 121 1 attempted to flee the area, but flew right into the path of the Imperial Star Destroyers and came under heavy fire from the enemy. Despite a fierce resistance from Rebel pilots and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] on the ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]''&mdash;who was trying to rescue his sister [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]] from the shipyard&mdash;most, if not all, of 121 1 was destroyed in the battle.
